_about: A07 extra checks, 23 Oct 2026. Reported, not tested: no trial, no gate, verdict of record unchanged (1 of 3, corrected list). Data: Season 1 cache (Factsheets/_data_private/p10_cache, 1 Oct 2026) on the corrected list's scores_panel (results_pit). Same crash target, per-date AUC and moving-block bootstrap (block 4, 10,000 draws, seed 42, one-sided p vs 0.5) as A07-1. Z'' = 6.56 WC/TA + 3.26 RE/TA + 6.72 EBIT/TA + 1.05 book equity/TL (Altman 1983/2002; Altman, Iwanicz-Drozdowska, Laitinen & Suvas 2017). Utilities/REIT-like = SIC 4900-4999, SIC 6798, or Sharadar sector Utilities/Real Estate (Sharadar TICKERS, SF1 table). Within-sector = Z ranked within Sharadar sector on each date. Piotroski fix = F missing when any of its inputs is missing. A07-4 re-run with scikit-learn logistic regression, C=1e6 (the registered fallback, Clarification 1; statsmodels not available).
